## Source: amazon-inspector (4f28ed1c404dad5afc7b70b345eeef6f81e04dcee77be3a7553956c7a43f8e7c)
On module load, index.js reads os.userInfo().username and issues an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded third-party collector at https://webhook.site/553dad0e-c841-46a8-b07d-213b52a24686/, transmitting the installer's local username to an anonymous external endpoint. The same top-level code performs AWS Instance Metadata Service reconnaissance against 169.254.169.254: it PUTs /latest/api/token to obtain an IMDSv2 session token and then GETs /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ to enumerate the IAM role attached to the host. Both behaviors fire automatically when the package is required, with no caller action.
